jd_text:
About the role: We are a growing fintech building API-first products and are hiring a Junior Backend Developer to join our platform team.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and maintain RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI
- Write efficient SQL queries and manage PostgreSQL schemas
- Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews
- Collaborate with frontend and product teams

Required skills: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/SQL, Git.
Preferred skills: Docker, Redis, SQLAlchemy.
Minimum experience: 1 year of professional backend experience (internships count). Graduates of 2024-2026 are encouraged to apply.

Our payments startup is looking for an early-career engineer to build the server-side web services behind our mobile and web apps.

Responsibilities:
- Build HTTP interfaces in Python using a modern asynchronous web framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation
- Model data in a relational database such as Postgres and tune slow queries
- Cover your work with automated tests and take part in peer code reviews

What we need: Python web services, an asynchronous Python web framework, relational database querying, version control.
Nice to have: containerisation, in-memory caching, an object-relational mapper.
Experience: about one year of hands-on work, internships included. Recent graduates (2024-2026) are welcome.

We are a small team and our product lives or dies on the reliability of the systems behind the screen. We want someone who has already shipped something real that other people's apps depend on, someone who has been paged because a slow query took the site down and fixed it.

You enjoy turning messy business rules into tidy services, you care about tests, and you pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly. This is a first or second role after graduating around 2024-2026, with roughly a year of real-world exposure (internships count).

About the role: Join our product engineering team to lead the design and delivery of customer-facing web applications.

Responsibilities:
- Architect and build features across React frontends and Node.js backends
- Deploy and operate services on AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3, ECS)
- Drive code quality, mentor engineers and lead design reviews

Required skills: React, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, SQL or NoSQL databases.
Preferred skills: Terraform, GraphQL, Docker, CI/CD.
Minimum experience: 5 years of professional full stack development, including ownership of production systems.

Lead delivery of our customer-facing web products end to end.

Responsibilities:
- Design component-based user interfaces with a declarative JavaScript UI library
- Build server-side services on a JavaScript runtime using statically typed JavaScript
- Run them on a public cloud provider's managed compute and database offerings
- Review designs and mentor teammates

What we need: component-based UI development, a server-side JavaScript runtime, statically typed JavaScript, public cloud managed services.
Nice to have: infrastructure automation, an API query language, containers, automated delivery pipelines.
Experience: five or more years of professional web engineering, including ownership of production systems.

Our product is growing and the people who built version one are stretched. We need a seasoned engineer who can take a feature from a rough idea on a whiteboard to a monitored production release, covering the interface, the services, the data and the deployment, without needing a ticket for each step.

You have seen systems fail at scale, steer design discussions without ego, and leave the codebase healthier than you found it. You have been doing this for at least five years.

About the role: We are looking for a Data Scientist / ML Engineer to build and deploy models powering search and personalisation.

Responsibilities:
- Develop, train and evaluate ML models with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Build data and feature pipelines using Pandas and SQL
- Run experiments, A/B tests and monitor models in production

Required skills: Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, SQL.
Preferred skills: MLflow, Docker, NLP.
Minimum experience: 2 years applied ML or data science experience.

Help us build the models behind search ranking and personalisation.

Responsibilities:
- Train neural networks with a leading deep learning framework
- Prepare data with tabular data-manipulation libraries and SQL
- Benchmark against classical machine-learning baselines and evaluate through controlled experiments

What we need: a deep learning framework, a tabular data-manipulation library, a classical machine-learning toolkit, relational querying.
Nice to have: experiment tracking, containerised model serving, natural language processing.
Experience: at least two years in an applied modelling role.

Our business has plenty of data and not enough answers. We need someone who can look at how customers behave, decide what is worth predicting, build something that predicts it better than a spreadsheet, and convince skeptical colleagues to act on it.

You have taken a model beyond a notebook at least once and know why it degraded afterwards. Two or more years of experience doing this, ideally on text or ranking problems.
required_skills: turning business questions into predictive models

jd_text:
About the role: Our platform team is hiring a DevOps & Cloud Engineer to run and scale our AWS infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
- Manage Kubernetes clusters and containerised workloads
- Provision infrastructure with Terraform on AWS
- Improve observability, reliability and cost efficiency

Required skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, AWS.
Preferred skills: Helm, Prometheus/Grafana, Python or Bash scripting.
Minimum experience: 3 years in DevOps, SRE or cloud engineering.

Own the reliability and delivery of our cloud workloads.

Responsibilities:
- Run containerised services on a container orchestration platform
- Define cloud resources through declarative infrastructure-as-code
- Maintain automated build-and-release pipelines on Amazon's cloud

What we need: a container orchestration platform, declarative infrastructure as code, automated build and release pipelines, Amazon Web Services.
Nice to have: a package manager for the orchestrator, metrics dashboards, scripting.
Experience: three or more years in operations, SRE or platform roles.

Developers here wait too long to ship and are woken too often at night. We want an engineer who has made a team's releases boring and its infrastructure reproducible: someone who treats servers as disposable, writes down what the cloud should look like instead of clicking around consoles, and measures reliability.

You have been responsible for a production environment for at least three years and can explain the trade-offs you made.

About the role: We are hiring a Mobile Developer to build and scale our consumer app on iOS and Android with Flutter.

Responsibilities:
- Build Flutter features with clean state management
- Integrate REST APIs and handle offline behaviour
- Own app releases to the Play Store and App Store

Required skills: Flutter, Dart, REST APIs, state management (BLoC/Provider/Riverpod), Git.
Preferred skills: Firebase, CI/CD for mobile, native Android or iOS experience.
Minimum experience: 2 years of mobile development.

Build and ship our consumer app to both Apple and Google stores from one shared codebase.

Responsibilities:
- Develop screens with Google's UI toolkit and its Dart language
- Manage app state with a reactive pattern and consume backend web services over HTTP
- Handle store releases

What we need: Google's cross-platform UI toolkit, Dart, HTTP web service integration, reactive state management, source control.
Nice to have: a mobile backend-as-a-service, mobile release automation, native platform integration.
Experience: two or more years building mobile apps.

Our users live on their phones, and the app is the product. We need someone who has put an app in real users' hands more than once, cares about smooth scrolling and sensible offline behaviour, and can take a feature from a design file to the store listing.

You will work closely with designers and backend engineers and handle release headaches yourself. You have been building mobile apps for at least two years.

About the role: Our quality team needs an Automation Engineer to design and scale end-to-end test automation.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain UI and API automation frameworks
- Integrate tests into CI pipelines and triage failures
- Partner with developers to improve testability

Required skills: Selenium, Cypress, Python, test automation, CI.
Preferred skills: pytest, API testing, Jenkins/GitHub Actions.
Minimum experience: 2 years in test automation.

Design and grow automated end-to-end testing for our web platform.

Responsibilities:
- Write browser-driven tests using a WebDriver-based tool and a modern JavaScript browser-testing framework
- Build a Python-based test harness and wire suites into continuous integration
- Analyse failures and keep the suite reliable

What we need: WebDriver-based browser automation, a JavaScript browser-testing framework, Python scripting for test harnesses, automated regression testing.
Nice to have: a Python test runner, HTTP service testing, CI servers.
Experience: two or more years in test automation.

We ship every week and our release anxiety is real. We need someone who can make us trust what we deploy: spot what could break, turn repetitive manual checks into reliable machine-run checks, and keep those checks from becoming flaky and ignored.

You will work alongside developers, not behind them. Around two years of experience making quality visible and cheaper.

About the role: Our security team is hiring a Cybersecurity Analyst to detect, investigate and reduce risk across our environment.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor and investigate alerts in our SIEM and lead incident response
- Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration tests
- Maintain network security controls and write detection rules

Required skills: Network security, SIEM, penetration testing, incident response.
Preferred skills: Splunk, Burp Suite, Python, OSCP/CEH/Security+.
Minimum experience: 2 years in security operations or penetration testing.

Protect our environment by detecting and responding to threats.

Responsibilities:
- Investigate alerts in a security event log-correlation platform
- Lead containment of confirmed incidents
- Harden perimeter and internal network defences
- Run authorised attack simulations against our applications and networks

What we need: a security event correlation platform, incident handling and containment, network defence hardening, authorised attack simulation.
Nice to have: commercial log analytics products, an intercepting-proxy testing tool, Python automation, an offensive-security certification.
Experience: two years of hands-on work.

Something odd is always happening on our network; our job is to know which oddities matter. We need someone who can read a trail of evidence, tell an annoyance from an intrusion, act fast when it is real, and think like an attacker to find weaknesses before others do.

You have done this under pressure for at least two years and have opinions about what good detection looks like.

About the role: We are hiring an Associate Product Manager to own features of our B2B SaaS platform, working closely with design and engineering.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct product discovery through customer interviews and data analysis
- Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria
- Maintain the product roadmap and prioritise the backlog in agile sprints
- Define and track success metrics

Required skills: Product discovery, user stories, roadmapping, agile, Jira.
Preferred skills: SQL, A/B testing, Figma.
Minimum experience: 1 year in product, business analysis or a related role (internships count). Graduates of 2022-2025 are encouraged to apply.

Support a product line for our subscription software.

Responsibilities:
- Talk to customers to uncover problems worth solving
- Turn findings into requirements written from the user's point of view with clear acceptance conditions
- Keep the plan of upcoming releases current
- Prioritise work with engineers in iterative cycles using an issue tracker

What we need: customer problem discovery, requirements from the user perspective, release planning, iterative delivery, an issue tracker.
Nice to have: data querying, controlled experimentation, design tools.
Experience: one year or more in product, analysis or similar (internships count). Graduates of 2022-2025 are encouraged to apply.

We are looking for someone curious about why people use our software and brave enough to say no to good ideas. You will learn to decide what the team builds next, work out what customers need rather than what they ask for, and keep engineers and stakeholders aligned.

You may be coming from design, analysis or marketing, but you have already had to prioritise competing demands and show a result. About a year of relevant work; 2022-2025 graduates welcome.

About the role: Our engineering organisation needs a Scrum Master to support two to three cross-functional product teams.

Responsibilities:
- Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
- Manage the backlog process and Jira workflows with product owners
- Remove impediments and track team metrics such as velocity and cycle time
- Coach teams and stakeholders on agile practices

Required skills: Scrum, Jira, sprint planning, agile methodologies, facilitation.
Preferred skills: Kanban, SAFe, Confluence, CSM or PSM certification.
Minimum experience: 3 years as a Scrum Master or agile delivery lead.

Help two to three product teams deliver predictably.

Responsibilities:
- Run the team rituals of the iterative framework: iteration planning, daily syncs, demos and retrospectives
- Keep work visible in a team tracking tool and report flow metrics
- Remove blockers and coach product owners

What we need: iterative-framework ceremonies, a team tracking tool, iteration planning, agile practices, team facilitation.
Nice to have: pull-based flow methods, a scaled agile framework, a team wiki, an agile facilitation certification.
Experience: three or more years in agile delivery.

Our teams work hard but surprise us on delivery dates. We need a coach who can get a room of engineers, designers and stakeholders talking honestly, help them shape their way of working, spot the bottleneck, and leave them more independent than before.

You have done this for several teams over three or more years and can show how outcomes improved.

About the role: We are seeking an Operations Manager to lead our distribution and fulfilment operations.

Responsibilities:
- Optimise end-to-end processes to reduce cost and cycle time
- Manage supply chain planning, inventory and logistics partners
- Negotiate and manage vendor contracts and service levels
- Lead a team of 30+ and own the operating budget

Required skills: Process optimisation, supply chain, vendor management, budgeting, team leadership.
Preferred skills: Lean Six Sigma, SAP or ERP systems, KPI management.
Minimum experience: 6 years in operations, with at least 2 years managing teams.

Lead our distribution and fulfilment network.

Responsibilities:
- Streamline end-to-end workflows to lower cost and shorten lead times
- Oversee procurement, inventory and carrier partners
- Negotiate supplier agreements and service levels
- Own the operating budget and manage a team of 30+

What we need: end-to-end workflow streamlining, procurement and inventory planning, supplier agreement negotiation, budget ownership, people management.
Nice to have: a continuous-improvement methodology certification, enterprise resource planning software, performance-indicator management.
Experience: six or more years, including two in people management.

Our operation grew faster than our processes. We need a seasoned manager who can walk the floor, see where time and money leak, fix it with a team rather than a memo, and keep suppliers honest.

You will run a large team, a real budget and a network of outside partners. You have done this at scale for six or more years and have the scars to show for it.

About the role: Our HR team is hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to hire engineers, data professionals and product roles.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with hiring managers to scope roles and plan sourcing
- Source candidates through LinkedIn, Boolean search and referrals
- Screen candidates technically and manage the pipeline in our ATS
- Improve time-to-hire and candidate experience

Required skills: Technical recruiting, sourcing, screening, ATS, stakeholder management.
Preferred skills: LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, Workday/Greenhouse, employer branding.
Minimum experience: 2 years of recruiting experience, ideally technical hiring.

Hire engineers, data and product talent for our growing company.

Responsibilities:
- Consult with hiring managers on role definition
- Find passive candidates using advanced search strings and professional networks
- Run first-round technical conversations
- Manage candidate flow in an applicant tracking system

What we need: consulting hiring managers, passive candidate search, technical first-round screening, an applicant tracking system.
Nice to have: an enterprise HR platform, employer-brand work, a premium recruiter licence.
Experience: at least two years of recruiting, preferably technical.

Great engineers are hard to find and easy to lose. We need someone who knows how to find people who are not looking, quickly tell whether they can really do the job, and make the process pleasant enough that they say yes.

You will work closely with busy managers who do not always know what they want. You have been hiring for technical teams for two or more years.

About the role: We are hiring a Financial Analyst to support strategic planning and investment decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain financial models, forecasts and budgets
- Perform DCF and comparable valuation for investments and acquisitions
- Pull and analyse data with SQL and communicate insights to leadership

Required skills: Financial modeling, Excel, DCF, valuation, SQL.
Preferred skills: Power BI or Tableau, VBA, Python, CFA progress.
Minimum experience: 2 years in financial analysis, FP&A, research or corporate finance.

Support planning and investment decisions with quantitative analysis.

Responsibilities:
- Build spreadsheet-based projections and forecasts
- Value businesses using discounted cash flow and market multiples
- Query company databases and explain results to executives

What we need: spreadsheet projection models, discounted cash flow, business valuation, database querying.
Nice to have: dashboard tools, spreadsheet macros, scripting, chartered-analyst progress.
Experience: two or more years in FP&A, research or corporate finance.

Business leaders keep asking whether a project is worth the money, and we need someone who can answer credibly. You will turn assumptions about the future into numbers, test how wrong they can be, and explain what it all means to people who do not speak finance.

You have two or more years of experience doing exactly that and can show the work.
required_skills: assessing what an investment is worth

jd_text:
About the role: Our advisory team is seeking an Investment Banking Associate to execute M&A and capital-raising mandates.

Responsibilities:
- Prepare pitchbooks, CIMs and client presentations
- Build merger, LBO and valuation models
- Lead financial due diligence workstreams and manage analysts

Required skills: M&A, pitchbooks, financial statements, due diligence, financial modeling.
Preferred skills: LBO, Capital IQ, PowerPoint, CFA.
Minimum experience: 3 years in investment banking, transaction services or private equity.

Execute advisory mandates for corporate clients on mergers, acquisitions and divestitures.

Responsibilities:
- Prepare client presentation decks
- Build integrated three-statement and transaction models
- Lead the financial investigation of target companies and mentor analysts

What we need: corporate mergers and acquisitions, client presentation decks, company financial report analysis, target-company financial investigation, transaction modelling.
Nice to have: leveraged buyout modelling, market data terminals, chartered-analyst progress.
Experience: three or more years in investment banking, transaction advisory or private equity.

Late nights are part of the deal. We want someone who has sat on a live transaction and knows what a buyer actually wants to see, who can build the story and the numbers behind it, find what is wrong inside a target before the other side does, and guide juniors without losing the deadline.

You have done this for three or more years.
required_skills: building the story and numbers behind a deal

jd_text:
About the role: We are hiring a Digital Marketing Specialist to drive customer acquisition across organic and paid channels.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and optimise SEO and SEM campaigns
- Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets and creative tests
- Analyse funnel and growth metrics and report on ROI

Required skills: SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, growth analytics.
Preferred skills: GA4, A/B testing, SEMrush, HubSpot.
Minimum experience: 2 years in digital marketing.

Drive customer acquisition through organic search and paid channels.

Responsibilities:
- Improve search-engine visibility
- Run paid search and paid social campaigns on Google's and Meta's ad platforms
- Measure funnel performance and return on spend

What we need: organic search optimisation, paid search advertising, paid social advertising, funnel and return-on-spend measurement.
Nice to have: a web analytics platform, controlled experiments, keyword research tools.
Experience: two or more years in digital marketing.

We need more of the right customers for less money. You will work out where they come from, decide where the next marketing budget goes, test ideas fast, and kill the ones that do not work.

You have been responsible for a budget and a number, and you can tell us which of your last ten ideas worked and why. Two or more years of hands-on digital experience.
required_skills: owning a budget and a target

jd_text:
About the role: Join our strategy team as a Business Strategy Analyst supporting market-entry and competitive decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct market research and size new opportunities
- Build competitive analyses and benchmarks
- Create dashboards in Power BI or Tableau and present findings to leadership

Required skills: Market research, competitive analysis, Power BI or Tableau, Excel.
Preferred skills: SQL, PowerPoint storytelling, consulting experience.
Minimum experience: 1 year in strategy, consulting or market research (internships count). Graduates of 2022-2025 are encouraged to apply.

Support strategic decisions with evidence.

Responsibilities:
- Size markets and gather customer and industry intelligence
- Benchmark competitors
- Present findings through dashboards in a business intelligence tool and in spreadsheets

What we need: market sizing and industry intelligence, competitor benchmarking, business intelligence dashboards, spreadsheets.
Nice to have: database querying, presentation storytelling.
Experience: one year or more in consulting, strategy or research (internships count). Graduates of 2022-2025 are encouraged to apply.

Leadership has big questions: should we enter that market, who are we really up against, where is our growth? We need a sharp analyst who can find the answer, show the evidence clearly, and tell a story an executive will remember.

You may come from consulting, research or analytics, but you have already turned a messy question into a clear recommendation. About a year of experience; 2022-2025 graduates welcome.
